devicesAdmin.title: Devices
devicesAdmin.form_topicHelp: Tasmota device topic (e.g. plug-living-room subscribes to tele/plug-living-room/SENSOR). Changes take effect after service restart.

configPanel.ledMode_0: disable use of LED as much as possible
configPanel.ledMode_1: show power state on LED (LED on when power on) (default)
configPanel.ledMode_2: show MQTT subscriptions as a LED blink
configPanel.ledMode_3: show power state and MQTT subscriptions as a LED blink
configPanel.ledMode_4: show MQTT publications as a LED blink
configPanel.ledMode_5: show power state and MQTT publications as a LED blink
configPanel.ledMode_6: show all MQTT messages as a LED blink
configPanel.ledMode_7: show power state and MQTT messages as a LED blink
configPanel.ledMode_8: LED on when Wi-Fi and MQTT are connected.
